name: Aimed Sharpshot
effects:
15 single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/Poison/NE ranged physical attacks, Critical Chance +50% to party, Sync Mode, Cap Break Level 1, Quad Element Mode III & Focused Shot to user
Attack (Machinist): 6 single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/Poison/NE ranged physical attacks
Defend (Machinist): 3 single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/Poison/NE ranged physical attacks, 0.825s CT, Quick Cast 3 to user
Quad Element Mode III: Lv.2 En-Fire/Ice/Lightning/Poison Stack
Focused Shot: After using 1/2/3/4/5+ Machinist abilities, grants Critical Chance +60/70/80/90/100% to party
Focused Shot: After using a Machinist ability, grants 250 SB Points to user (max 1 chase)
Focused Shot: Critical Chance +100% to party with at least 4 T members
